nodes.label: Out of Scope Boundaries (no payment, delivery, meat, forecasting)
nodes.rationale: Payment happens directly at pickup; no delivery, refunds, lab inspection, price enforcement or predictive forecasting.

nodes.label: Claims to Avoid (score is priority not freshness)
nodes.rationale: The visibility score is a promotion priority, not a freshness score; descriptive reports do not predict purchases or prove fraud.

nodes.label: Administrator Role
nodes.rationale: PDF discusses admin functions but formal requirements list only sellers, buyers, stakeholders; permissions need a dedicated decision.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Principle
nodes.rationale: Every protected page, mobile action and API request needs role checks; stakeholder access stays aggregate-only.

nodes.label: Local Research Base (82 participants, 3 Davao sites)
nodes.rationale: Bankerohan, Agdao and DFTC; findings do not represent all Davao City markets.

nodes.label: Survey Findings That Drive Design
nodes.rationale: Seller price lowering, 95.1% want recent photos, 97.6% want seller legitimacy evidence, buyers willing to self-pickup.

nodes.label: Marketable Surplus
nodes.rationale: Seller-declared vegetables beyond expected demand; platform does not certify freshness or food safety.

nodes.label: Core Value Loop (post, discover, reserve, QR, pickup)
Project Stack (React Native, Next.js, ElysiaJS, Better Auth, PostgreSQL)
Reservation State Transitions (active, cancelled, expired, completed)
Reservation Invariants (atomic stock, no double confirm)
nodes.rationale: Quantities never negative; confirmed pickup cannot repeat; stock changes atomic; cancelled/expired cannot complete.

nodes.label: Advisory Language Rule (no freshness claims)
nodes.rationale: Tell sellers to inspect and update photos; never claim produce is fresh, spoiled, safe or will spoil at a given hour.

nodes.label: AHP-TOPSIS Visibility Engine (visibility-ahptopsis-v1)
nodes.rationale: Weights Freshness 40%, Stock Availability 30%, Seller Reliability 20%, Historical Surplus Recurrence 10%; Priority Boost needs Ci* >= 0.60.

nodes.label: Seller-Confirmed Boost Visibility Workflow
nodes.rationale: Seller confirmation, not the score, triggers social posting; idempotent per listing cycle.

nodes.label: n8n workflow automation
nodes.rationale: Receives only job/boost IDs and fetches context through a protected backend route; holds no DB or provider credentials.

nodes.label: Backend / n8n / Text Model / Seller Responsibility Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Backend is source of truth for eligibility, prices and idempotency; n8n and LLM never calculate visibility or change prices.

nodes.label: Sell-through Rate
nodes.rationale: Completed pickup quantity / posted quantity x 100; reserved, cancelled or expired quantity is not a sale.

nodes.label: Completed-Sales Change
nodes.rationale: Show not computable instead of dividing by zero.

nodes.label: Weighted Trust Evaluation (monitoring-v3)
nodes.rationale: Default weights 1/2/1 points; thresholds warning 3, restriction 5, blocked 8; prototype policy values, disabled until validated (TRUST_ACTIONS_ENABLED=false).

nodes.label: Account Actions (warning, temporary restriction, block, OTP recovery)
Fairness and Privacy Rules (reports are allegations)
nodes.rationale: Unsupported reports contribute zero points; duplicate events must not inflate scores; evidence stays out of public views.

nodes.label: Prototype Visibility Score V = 0.40P + 0.40Q + 0.20R
nodes.rationale: P posting age/12h, Q remaining quantity ratio, R recurrence/3; prototype settings, not agricultural standards.

nodes.label: Visibility Tiers (Basic, Standard, Priority Boost)
nodes.rationale: Thresholds 0.40 and 0.70 compared exactly, not on rounded display values.

nodes.label: Signed QR Payload (ORDER_QR_SECRET)
nodes.rationale: Changing the secret invalidates QR payloads of pending orders; backend returns a string, not an image.

nodes.label: Planned Cart Checkout (one order per seller)
Seller Mobile Design Guide (mobile/DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Single canonical palette resolving the draft's two palettes and removing the buyer cart pattern.

nodes.label: Backend Module Layout (index/, model/, services/, utils/)
nodes.rationale: Routes in index/, validation and DTOs in model/, DB and business logic in services/ with one exported function per file; shared code in utils/.

nodes.label: Server-side .env Secret Rule
nodes.rationale: Mobile and web .env values can be exposed in client builds, so secrets stay in ignored server-side .env with placeholder .env.example.

nodes.label: Seller Onboarding Mockup and Logo Assets
Duplicate Listing Guard (409 plus advisory lock)
nodes.rationale: Existing duplicates are preserved; a unique index would need an explicit data cleanup decision.

nodes.label: Expo File Append for Avatar Upload (expo-file-system)
nodes.rationale: Expo fetch rejects plain {uri,name,type} form parts with Unsupported FormDataPart implementation.

nodes.label: Inline Field-Keyed Validation Errors
nodes.rationale: Each field shows its own error below the input; form-wide failures go near the submit action; neutral invalid-credentials wording.
